verdict.rationale: Autumn documents plan definition in code via `atmn` and `autumn.config.ts`. Its attach endpoint handles new subscriptions, upgrades and downgrades, consolidated into Stripe subscriptions. It also offers previewAttach to show charges before a subscription change, multi-phase schedules, a customer portal, and plan-change webhooks; a community thread notes the team handled annual/monthly transitions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of free trials, explicit proration behavior (only implied by previewAttach), independent hands-on corroboration of upgrade flows.
